versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Figma Design Brief skill.
- Generates a structured design brief from PRDs, feature requests, or user stories.
- Output includes project header, goals, user flows, screens, component requirements, constraints, and open questions.
- Designed to clarify what needs designing in Figma, not how to design it.
- Focuses on reusing design system components and clearly defining success criteria and unresolved questions.
